headline: Jumia Reports Two-Thirds of Kenyan Customers Located Outside Nairobi
summary: E-commerce platform Jumia stated that 67.6 percent of its active customers in Kenya are based outside Nairobi as it prepares for its Black Friday event.
why: Regional demographic and customer distribution insights help e-commerce companies optimize logistics and regional fulfillment strategies.

impacts.name: Jumia Technologies AG
impacts.why: Understanding geographic customer concentration is crucial for optimizing supply chain and operational costs.
